changelog.note: Items as data: every trick is read from scrawl-items.js, the same file the page uses; trick behaviour fingerprinted identical to 1.4.0 on page and sim.
Tiered equipment from the 21 Nov daily: 15-trick roster (common / uncommon / rare from the 1.2.0 trials), tiered Armoury offers; Swap, Rotate, Vowel Shift, Split and Ink Blot retired from offers.

Endless descent (deep runs: foes keep coming, every third is The Editor, +10% attack per set of three); fair draws from the 21 Nov daily on (no consonant twice in a hand, one of JQXZ, one of FKVWY), matching the page; fixtures recaptured.
Exactly reproducible (ties between equal plays now break the same way in every process); every trial includes all live tricks as controls, so the keeper bar is the same in every round.
Evolution rounds (trial, idea files with lineage, choose and pair trick kinds), selftest against the page, Lab snapshots.
Port of the four-card kit rules (Spellblade up to 6, daily edge, foe HP x1.22); notools, smart and eager bots; compare, sweep, report.
